newsitem.title: USA: Connetics reports positive trial results.
newsitem.headline: Connetics reports positive trial results.

text.p: Connetics Corp said Tuesday results from its Phase III clinical trial to treat scalp psoriasis showed positive results.

The company said in a statement that its betamethasone mousse, a novel foam formulation of betamethasone valerate, demonstrated statistically significant improvement over placebo for the treatment of scalp psoriasis, a condition that affects about three million Americans.

Connetics said it plans to file a New Drug Application with the Food and Drug Administration to market the product for use in all steroid-responsive dermatoses, including psoriasis, in the first quarter 1998.

The 190-patient study showed that overall 71 percent of patients treated with the mousse formulation had complete or almost complete clearance compared with 46 percent for lotion and 18 percent for placebo.
